summary: Iteration 5 verified replacement of stock product photos with user's real equipment photos. Backend API /api/products returns 26 products: 20 heroes point to /products/<slug>/1.jpg and 6 (tipper, power-transfer-system, ibc, pallet-weighing-truck, bin-wash-system, cip-wip-skid) correctly retain stock image keys (plant_1 / machinery_1 / laboratory_2). All real-photo product pages render hero + gallery with multiple real images and zero broken images. Direct asset URLs return HTTP 200 with correct content-types. All 4 real PDF datasheets are served (binder-preparation-vessel 385KB, high-shear-mixer-granulator 2.9MB, high-shear-mixer-granulator-r2t 279KB, oscillating-granulator 458KB) and the Downloads 'Product Datasheet' link on those product pages points directly to /products/<slug>/datasheet.pdf with target=_blank, while v-blender (no PDF) shows mailto downloads only. Homepage bento displays 11 real-photo products as expected. Admin panel login works with the provided credentials, product list shows 26 items, V-Blender hero field shows /products/v-blender/1.jpg, Tipper hero shows stock key plant_1. 404 state for /product/saizoner works. Mega menu categories render.

issues: 4.jpg shows a co-mill nameplate — per task note this is intentional (user organized ZIP that way), noted here for awareness only

critical_code_review_comments: Real photos installation is clean: REAL_PHOTOS/DATASHEETS overlay pattern in products.js keeps data consistent across hero/gallery/related and the img() helper correctly passes through direct /products/* paths while mapping stock keys through IMAGES.

Admin product edit form has no file-upload for hero/gallery; hero is a free-text 'Hero image key' field. Not a bug for this task but may surface later when editors need to add new products with real photos.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 20 real-photo product directories exist under /app/frontend/public/products/<slug>/ with 1.jpg..N.jpg. 4 datasheet PDFs confirmed. 6 stock-photo products intentionally retain unsplash URLs via keys plant_1/machinery_1/laboratory_2 — do not treat as a bug. Backend /api/products returns correct hero values. If retesting, use the Preview URL from frontend/.env (REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL).
